Downard family · Person

Thomas John Downard

1921–1982

Open in the family tree

Born
December 3, 1921 · Bluebell, Utah
Died
May 22, 1982 · Salt Lake City, Utah
Occupations
Postal Service

Born in Bluebell. Served in the U.S. Army during World War II with the 136th Infantry Regiment, 33rd Infantry Division, including service in Alaska and the Pacific; later worked for the Postal Service; remembered for baseball, family and generosity.

Family information describes US Army service during World War II and later Postal Service work. The unit assignment awaits service records. The family record and newspaper summary give different dates for his wedding to Norma.
